ResourcesQuelea.title: Quelea projection, Bibles, hymnals and much more
ResourcesQuelea.intro: Quelea is free and open-source church projection software. This page gathers official links and compatible resources so churches can get started without affecting their budget.
ResourcesQuelea.officialBadge: Information gathered from the official Quelea website
ResourcesQuelea.downloadText: The main download should come from the official project. According to the docs, Quelea runs on Windows, macOS and Linux; Windows is the most stable platform for most users.
ResourcesQuelea.manualText: Quelea provides official manuals, including Spanish and English versions.
ResourcesQuelea.biblesText: Quelea can add Bibles in XML or XMM format from the Bible tab. Each edition downloads directly from its original source; review every license before using it in your church.
ResourcesQuelea.songsText: These databases were put together and maintained by brothers from different churches so each congregation can get started without typing songs one by one. Import them from Database > Import > Quelea song package (QSP).
ResourcesQuelea.fullCollectionText: If your church works in more than one language, this option puts everything in a single file. It is large, so download it only once.
steps: Download and install Quelea from the official link for your operating system.
Open Quelea and review the display/projector setup before using it in a real service.
To add Bibles: open Options/Settings, go to the Bible tab, click Add bible and select the downloaded XML file.
To use a Bible passage: open the Bible tab, choose version, book, chapter and verses, then click Add to Schedule.
To import songs: go to Database > Import, choose the compatible file type, select the downloaded resource and check duplicates before importing.
Run a complete test: add songs, Bible passages, images or videos to the Order of Service and send each item to Live.
ResourcesQuelea.helpText: If a church wants to implement Quelea, I will gladly guide them step by step. There is no charge for this help. If they want to support the time invested, they may give a voluntary donation, but it is not required.
ResourcesQuelea.note: Note: Quelea and its official resources belong to their respective authors. This page organizes reference links; each church must review every resource license before downloading or using it.
